description: FULL BODY, a Malaysian man in his late 30s, athletic build, wearing a crisp dark navy blue Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) uniform with silver badges on the shoulders and a name tag that reads 'AMIR'. He has short, neat black hair and is wearing polished black leather tactical boots.

FULL BODY, a Malaysian man in his early 30s, wearing a smart-casual office outfit consisting of a light gray button-down shirt with sleeves rolled up to the elbows, dark navy chinos, and brown leather loafers. He has a clean-shaven face and short, modern black hair.
